title: Kéo language
description: Austronesian language spoken in Flores, Indonesia
extract: Kéo or Nagé-Kéo is a Malayo-Polynesian dialect cluster spoken by the Kéo and the Nage peoples that reside in an area southeast of the Ebulobo volcano in the south-central part of Nusa Tenggara Timur Province on the island of Flores, eastern Indonesia, largely in the eponymous Nagekeo Regency.
